meta.title: LingoLinq Findings Snapshots
meta.description: Append-only time series of findings-register states, used to derive risk movement (new / movedOutOfOpen / reopened / severityChanged) between generations. Every snapshot stores the full open-finding ID set so flow is derived from prior/current ID sets, never from mutable counters. Multiple snapshots per day are allowed; generatedAt (full ISO 8601 timestamp) is the unique identity. Prior snapshots must never be mutated or reordered. Snapshots are appended ONLY by `ruby scripts/readiness-check.rb --snapshot` - the one mode permitted to read the wall clock.
meta.governance: Append-only. Nobody hand-edits or reorders existing snapshot records; the validator hard-fails on identity collision, timestamp regression, or a stored flow that disagrees with the flow recomputed from adjacent openFindingIds sets.
